description: Restore an older page version by saving it as a new version; intervening history stays. Requires edit access. Pass the current ifVersion from anyforge_get_page; stale versions are refused with 409. This does not publish a draft. Only call when the person asked to restore it.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_restore_page_version
title: Restore page version
